newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Eletropaulo still a buy.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Eletropaulo still a buy.

text.p: -- Robert Fleming Inc said it is reiterating its buy rating on Sao Paulo power firm Eletropaulo as well as raising its 1996 and 1997 earnings forecasts for the firm.
-- The brokerage cited the surge in Eletropaulo's third-quarter net income to 68.8 million reais compared with 9.4 million reais in the first half.
-- As a result, Fleming said it is raising its operating cash flow estimate for Eletropaulo to 1.019 billion reais from 942 million reais.

-- The brokerage projects a 452 million-real operating profit in 1996 and 688.2 million reais in 1997 and forecasts a 132.7 million-real net profit this year and 379.9 million reais next year, it said.
-- So far this year, the firm has seen a 44.7 percent rise in sales, only slightly offset by a 9.1 percent rise in operating expenses compared with the same period last year, said Fleming.
-- Eletropaulo's preferred B share, which closed Friday at 120 reais, was untraded by 1043 local/1343 EST on the Sao Paulo Stock Exchange.
